Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including detailed data on building age, size, classrooms, specialized spaces, and detailed site plans; robust condition assessment covering major systems with cost estimates and contingency planning (Chunks 1-20, 50).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Detailed enrollment projections with methodology, capacity utilization by site and grade, and explicit connection to facility actions including portable exclusions and new construction eligibility (Chunks 1-5, 50, 52).

Educational Alignment.justification: Limited references to educational goals and programs (e.g., CTE, special education) but no comprehensive educational specifications or direct connection of projects to educational needs (no explicit educational alignment sections found).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Provides data and analysis of outdoor spaces including playfields, hard courts, shade structures, and fencing; identifies strategies for improvement such as shade structures and irrigation upgrades, but lacks districtwide greening data or climate resilience framing (Chunks 6-26).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Acknowledges some climate-related issues indirectly (e.g., rodent damage, drainage problems) but no comprehensive climate risk assessment or integrated climate resilience strategies evident in the plan (Chunks 6, 31).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Includes energy efficiency strategies such as solar photovoltaic installations at multiple sites, EMS upgrades, and references to Title 24 and state goals; discusses energy resilience goals but lacks fully comprehensive districtwide resilience strategy (Chunks 46-47).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Presents a comprehensive financial plan with detailed cost estimates, escalation, contingencies, prioritization, multiple funding sources including bonds, state programs, developer fees, and endowments; aligns financial capacity with district priorities (Chunks 52-55).
